R6L-bear-backcountry-0001.name: 1.1 km SE of Iskut River
R6L-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6L-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed paved road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2016 (10 years old), 40 m S: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2019 (fire R90900), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 35 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 102 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.70487, -130.57393, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.6 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 647 m, about 177 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 630 m W of the spot at 292 m (56.75663, -130.58701). Water: VERIFY water (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-21, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.

R6L-grouse-atv-0003.name: By Estshi Creek
R6L-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R6L-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Main Line); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 117 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.8401, -130.50596, where the truck road ends (Main Line); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Main Line stretch, 5.8 km one way. About 116 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-21, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
